subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A recipe tells people how to make something.”?
options: A device's shape tells a story about what its makers think matters.
What people throw away tells a story.
The artist must still choose what matters."
A story tells them why it matters.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「A device's shape tells a story about what its makers think matters.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「What people throw away tells a story.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The artist must still choose what matters.'」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A recipe tells people how to make something. A story tells them why it matters.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A recipe tells people how to make something. A story tells them why it matters.」，答案為「A story tells them why it matters.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A story tells them why it matters.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
